senses.gloss: प्रज प्र-ज. See under प्र-जन् below.

प्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, bearing (in
अ-प्˚, q. v.); (अस्), m. a husband; (आ), f. progeny,
offspring, brood, children and children's children,
posterity, descendants, race, family; a creature,
created being; man, mankind, people, subjects;
seed, semen; birth, generation, propagation.
—प्र-
जा-कर, अस्, m. a symbolical expression for ‘a
sword;’ (perhaps an error for प्रज्ञा-कर.)
—प्रजा-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of offspring,
wishing for children.
—प्रजा-कार, अस्, m. the
maker of created beings, author of creation.
—प्र-
जा-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. killing offspring, destroying
[]
progeny.
—प्रजा-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘a moon to his
subjects,’ epithet of a prince.
—प्रजा-तन्तु, उस्, m.
a line of descendants, a race.
—प्रजा-द, अस्, आ,
अम्, granting offspring; removing barrenness (as a
medicine &c.); (आ), f. a species of shrub (= गर्-
भ-दात्री).
—प्रजा-दान, अम्, n. ‘people's gift,’
silver.
—प्रजा-द्वार, अम्, n. ‘a gate or means of
obtaining progeny,’ epithet of the sun.
—प्रजा-
धर्म, अस्, m. the duty of children or of subjects.
—प्रजाध्यक्ष (˚जा-अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘the super-
intendent or leader of created beings,’ an epithet
of the sun; of Kardama; of Dakṣa; [cf. प्रजा-
पति.]
—प्रजा-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘protector or lord of
created beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Manu; of
Dakṣa; a protector of subjects, a king, prince.
—प्रजा-निषेक, अस्, m. ‘infusion of offspring,’
impregnation; the infused germ itself, offspring.
—प्रजान्तक (˚जा-अन्˚), अस्, m. the god of death.
—प्रजा-प, अस्, m. ‘protector of subjects,’ a king,
prince.
—प्रजा-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of creatures,’ an
epithet in the Veda originally applied to Savitṛ,
Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, Hiraṇya-garbha, Indra, and Agni,
afterwards the name of a separate god presiding
over procreation [cf. Manu XII. 121] and the be-
stower of progeny and cattle, sometimes invoked
as the ‘Creator’ and sometimes invoked only as
one of the thirty-three deities, (in more recent hymns
and Brāhmaṇas sometimes identified with the uni-
verse, and described like Brahma as the original
self-existent Being or source out of which the uni-
verse was evolved); an epithet of the ten lords of
created beings first created by Brahmā (according to
Manu I. 34; their names are Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras,
Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Pra-cetas or
Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nārada; some authorities make
these Prajā-patis only seven in number, counting
only the first seven in the above list, others reduce
them to the last three, viz. Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and
Nārada); an epithet of Śiva; ‘lord of the people,’
a king, sovereign, prince; a daughter's husband, son-
in-law; a creator, procreator, father (as generator); a
kind of insect; the fifth (or thirty-ninth) year in a
sixty years' cycle of Jupiter; a particular star, ò Aurigæ;
(in astrol.) = 2. काल-नर, q. v.; the sun; fire;
N. of a man; of a Ṛṣi; (ई), f., N. of Śākya-
muni's aunt and nurse with the patronymic Gautamī
(the first woman who assented to the doctrines of
Buddha; cf. महा-प्रजापती, महा-प्रजावती).
—प्रजापति-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. created by
Prajā-pati (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रजापति-
सृष्ट).
—प्रजापति-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the
lords of created beings,’ an epithet of Dakṣa.
—प्र-
जापति-भक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eaten by Prajā-
pati.
—प्रजापति-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘the sacrifice per-
formed to Prajā-pati (as the deity presiding over
procreation of offspring),’ the procreation of children
enjoined by law.
—प्रजापति-लोक, अस्, m. the
world of Prajā-pati situated between the sphere of
Brahmā and that of the Gandharvas.
—प्रजापति-
शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man.
—प्रजापति-सृष्ट,
अस्, आ, अम्, created by Prajā-pati.
—प्रजापति-
हृदय, अम्, n., Ved. ‘Prajāpati's heart,’ N. of a
Sāman (also called प्रजापतेर् हृदयम्).
—प्र-
जापत्य, an incorrect form for प्राजापत्य, q. v.
—प्रजा-पाल or प्रजा-पालक, अस्, m. ‘protector
of created beings,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; a protector
of subjects, a king, sovereign; N. of a prince.
—प्रजा-पालन, अम्, n. the protection of subjects.
—प्रजा-पालि, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; [cf. गो-
पालि.]
—प्रजापाल्य, अम्, n. the office of protector
of the people, royal office.
—प्रजामृतत्व (˚जा-
अम्˚), अम्, n., Ved. perpetuity of posterity.
—प्र-
जार्थम् or प्रजार्थे (˚जा-अर्˚), ind. for the sake of
offspring.
—प्रजा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied by
progeny, having offspring or children, abounding in
progeny, prolific; pregnant; having subjects; (अती),
f. a brother's wife; the wife of an elder brother; a
mother, matron; N. of a tutelary deity of the Su-
mantus; of the wife of Priya-vrata.
—प्रजा-विद्, त्,
त्, त्, or प्रजा-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bestowing or
granting progeny.
—प्रजा-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase
[]
of progeny.
—प्रजा-सृज्, ट्, m. ‘the creator of
beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Kaśyapa.
—प्रजा-
हित, अस्, आ, अम्, favourable to or good for children
or subjects, kind or useful to children or subjects;
(अम्), n. water.
—प्रजेप्सु (˚जा-ईप्˚), उस्, उस्, उ,
wishing to obtain offspring, desirous of progeny.
—प्रजेश (˚जा-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of created beings,’
an epithet of the god presiding over the procreation
of offspring; ‘lord of the people,’ a prince, king,
sovereign.
—प्रजेश्वर (˚जा-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of
the people,’ a sovereign, king.
—प्रजोत्पत्ति (˚जा-
उत्˚), इस्, f. or प्रजोत्पादन (˚जा-उत्˚), अम्, n. the
raising up of progeny.

प्रजन् प्र-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्,
to be born, be produced, come into existence, spring
up; to become an embryo; to be born again; to
propagate offspring (with inst.), beget, generate,
cause to conceive; to bring forth, be delivered of,
bear: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to cause any one
(acc.) to propagate offspring (inst., Ved., Sāy. =
प्रोद्भूतं कृ); to cause to be born; to beget,
generate; to bring forth, bear; to produce, cause,
occasion: Desid. -जिजनिषते, to wish to be born:
Desid. of Caus. -जिजनयिषति, to wish to cause to
be conceived.

1. प्र-जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ, able to beget (in अ-प्˚,
q. v.; for 2. प्र-जज्ञि see under 1. प्र-ज्ञा, col. 3).

2. प्र-जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ (for 1. see col. 2), Ved.
conversant with.

प्र-जन, अस्, अम्, m. n. (usually m.), begetting,
generating, impregnating, generation; impregnation
or pregnancy of cattle; bearing, bringing forth;
(अस्), m. one who begets, a generator, impregnator,
progenitor.
—प्रजनार्थम् (˚न-अर्˚), ind. for the
sake of procreation.
प्राजन, अस्, अम्, m. n. a whip, goad.

प्र-जनन, अस्, ई, अम्, begetting, generating,
generative, procreative, vigorous (according to Mahī-
dhara = प्रजोत्पादक); (अम्), n. the act of gene-
ration, procreation, propagation, conception in the
womb; the act of bringing forth, delivery, birth;
production; generative energy, procreative power,
semen; the generative organ, penis, vulva; off-
spring, children; = प्र-गम; = प्र-गत.
—प्र-
जनन-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in midwifery.
—प्रजनन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing
generative power.

प्र-जनयितृ, ता, m., Ved. a generator, begetter,
progenitor.
प्र-जनिका, f. a mother.

प्र-जनिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, generative, procreative,
prolific, productive, generating, producing; being
born or produced; growing or standing (as corn).

प्र-जनिष्यमाणा, f. about to bring forth, being
near the time of delivery.

प्र-जनुक, अस्, m. the body; (perhaps an in-
correct form.)

प्र-जनू, ऊस्, f., Ved. the vulva, pudenda muli-
ebria.

प्र-जस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, = प्र-ज (at the end of a
comp.; cf. दुष्-प्˚, बहु-प्˚).

प्र-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; impreg-
nating; (आ), f. a woman who has borne a child.

प्र-जाति, इस्, f. generating, generation, procreation,
propagation, production; bringing forth, delivery,
travail, labour; generative power; (इस्), m., N. of a
prince.
—प्रजाति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing
words relating to generation.

प्र-जायिनी, f. being about to bring forth; bearing,
bringing forth, a mother (at the end of comps., e. g.
अभिरूप-प्रजायिनी, bearing handsome children;
cf. वीर-प्˚).

प्र-जिजनिषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wishing to
be born.

प्रजप् प्र-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपितुम्,
to recite in a low tone, whisper, mutter.
प्रजय प्र-जय. See under प्र-जि, col. 3.
प्र-जय, अस्, m., Ved. victory, conquest.

प्राजया प्राजया, see Gaṇa Sākṣādādi to
Pāṇ. I. 4, 74.

प्रजल्प् प्र-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्पि-
तुम्, to prattle, gossip, chatter; to speak, talk; to
communicate, proclaim, announce.

प्र-जल्प, अस्, m. prattle, gossip, heedless or
frivolous words (especially such as used in greeting
a lover).
प्र-जल्पन, अम्, n. talking, speaking.

प्र-जल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, talked, chattered; one who
has begun to talk; (अम्), n. spoken words, talk.
प्रजव प्र-जव. See under प्र-जू, col. 3.

प्र-जव, अस्, m., Ved. haste, rapidity; (अम्),
ind. hastily, rapidly.

प्रजागृ प्र-जागृ, cl. 2. P. -जागर्ति, -जागरि-
तुम्, to watch, keep watch, watch over (with loc.);
to lie in wait for (with gen.): Caus. -जागरयति,
-यितुम्, to wake (trans.).

प्र-जागर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who wakes, waking,
an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अस्), m. a guardian; the act
of waking or watching, lying awake at night, sleep-
lessness, being awake, being roused, awaking; taking
care; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras.
प्र-जागरण, अम्, n. being awake, sleeplessness.

प्रजानि प्र-जानि, इस्, m., N. of a prince;
(a various reading for प्र-जाति.)

प्रजि प्र-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to
win, conquer, overpower, subdue.
प्रज्जि प्रज्जि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
प्र-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering, defeating.

प्रजित प्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged
on; (probably a wrong form for प्राजित fr. rt. अज्
with प्र.)

प्रजिन प्रजिन, अस्, m. wind, air; (also
read प्रजीन.)

प्रजिन्व् प्र-जिन्व्, cl. 1. P. -जिन्वति, -जिन्वि-
तुम्, Ved. to refresh, animate; to promote, help,
assist.

प्रजिहीर्षु प्र-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.
of rt. हृ with प्र), being about to strike or hit,
wishing to strike.

प्रजीवन प्र-जीवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जीव् with
प्र), livelihood, subsistence.

प्र-जीविन्, ई, m., N. of a minister of Megha-varṇa
the king of the crows.

प्रजुष्ट प्र-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जुष्
with प्र), strongly attached to, devoted to, intent
on (= प्र-सक्त, Manu II. 96).

प्रजू प्र-जू, cl. 1. P. A. -जवति, -ते, &c., to
hasten forwards; to set in rapid motion, push or
drive on; to urge on, incite: Caus. -जावयति,
-यितुम्, to set in rapid motion, let fly, dart, shoot.

प्र-जवित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven on, impelled; in-
cited, urged on.

प्र-जविन्, ई, इनी, इ, hastening, rapid, swift, speedy;
(ई), m. a runner, courier, express.

प्रजृम्भ् प्र-जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. -जृम्भते,
जृम्भितुम्, to begin to yawn.

प्रजॄ प्र-जॄ, cl. 4. P. -जीर्यति, -जरितुम्,
-जरीतुम्, to be digested.

प्रज्जटिक प्रज्जटिक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a kind of Prākṛt metre (= Prākṛt पज्जलिआ).
प्रज्ञ 1. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-ज्ञु, q. v.

2. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, intelligent, learned;
(at the end of a comp.) knowing, conversant with;
(आ), f. a clever or sensible woman; intelligence, un-
derstanding, intellect, wisdom, knowledge; discern-
ment, discrimination, judgment; device, design, de-
termination; Wisdom personified as the goddess of
arts and eloquence, Sarasvatī; (with Buddhists) the
energy of the Ādi-buddha.
—प्रज्ञ-ता, f., Ved.
knowledge.
—प्रज्ञा-कर, अस्, m., N. of the author
of a commentary on the Nalodaya.
—प्रज्ञा-काय,
अस्, m. an epithet of Mañju-śrī a Buddhist saint.
—प्रज्ञा-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—प्रज्ञा-गुप्त-शरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
[]
body protected by understanding.
—प्रज्ञा-चक्षुस्,
उस्, उस्, उस्, ‘mind-eyed,’ ‘having the understanding
or wisdom as the only eyes,’ blind; (उस्), m. an
epithet of the blind king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—प्रज्ञा-
ढ्य (˚ञा-आढ्˚), अस्, m. ‘rich in wisdom,’ N. of a
man.
—प्रज्ञादित्य (˚ञा-आद्˚), अस्, m. ‘sun of
wisdom,’ N. of a man.
—प्रज्ञा-पारमिता, f. (with
Buddhists) one of the six perfections, perfection in
wisdom, (the other five are दान-प्˚, शील-प्˚, क्षान्-
ति-प्˚, वीर्य-प्˚, and ध्यान-प्˚); N. of a Buddhist
work.
—प्रज्ञा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consist-
ing of wisdom.
—प्रज्ञा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing
wisdom, wise, knowing, intelligent.
—प्रज्ञा-वर्-
मन्, आ, m. ‘having wisdom for armour,’ N. of a
man.
—प्रज्ञा-वाद, अस्, m. a wise speech, wise
saying.
—प्रज्ञा-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, old in wisdom
or knowledge.
—प्रज्ञा-सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘hav-
ing wisdom for a companion,’ wise, intelligent.
—प्रज्ञा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of wisdom,
ignorant, silly, unwise.

प्रज्ञा 1. प्र-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जा-
नीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to know, understand (especially said
of knowing a way or mode of action); to distinguish,
discern, discriminate; to know of, know about, be
acquainted with; to become aware of, to find out,
discover: Caus. -ज्ञपयति, -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्,
to show or point out (the way); to discover, betray;
to summon, invite.

प्राज्ञ प्राज्ञ, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. प्र-ज्ञा),
intellectual, (opposed to शारीर, तैजस); intelligent,
wise, clever; patient in investigation; (Ved.) having
no deep insight; (अस्), m. a wise or learned man, a
Paṇḍit, a skilful or clever man; a kind of parrot
with red stripes on the neck and wings; (आ or ई), f.
a clever or intelligent woman; (ई), f. the wife of an
intellectual man, wife of a Paṇḍit; (आ), f. intelligence,
understanding.
—प्राज्ञ-कथा, f. a story of a wise
man, tale about a wise man.
—प्राज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n.
or प्राज्ञ-ता, f. wisdom, learning.
—प्राज्ञ-मान,
अम्, n. respect for learned men.
—प्राज्ञ-मानिन् or
प्राज्ञम्-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, thinking one's self wise,
fancying one's self a learned man.

प्र-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. teaching, informing, doctrine,
communication; an appointment, agreement, en-
gagement; (with Jainas) a particular magical art per-
sonified as one of the Vidyā-devīs (also प्र-ज्ञप्ती).
—प्रज्ञप्ति-कौशिक, अस्, m., N. of a teacher
acquainted with the magical art called Pra-jñapti.
—प्रज्ञप्ति-वादिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist
sect.
—प्रज्ञप्ति-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist
work.

प्र-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, understood; dis-
tinguished, discriminated, discerned, discernible, dis-
tinct, clear; renowned, famous, notorious.

प्र-ज्ञाति, इस्, f., Ved. knowing the way (to any
place), knowing the right way.

प्र-ज्ञातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who knows the
right way, a skilful guide, conductor.

प्र-ज्ञात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्˚, losing or
missing the way.

प्र-ज्ञान, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, prudent, wise, clever,
learned; easily known (Ved.); (अम्), n. knowledge,
knowing one's duty, wisdom, intelligence; discrimina-
tion; a mark, sign, token, memorial.
—प्रज्ञान-
सन्तति, इस्, f. a train of thought.

प्र-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, betrayed, disclosed, dis-
covered.
प्रज्ञाल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent.

प्रज्ञिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wise, prudent; (ई), m. a wise
or learned man, sage, scholar.
प्रज्ञिल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent, clever.

प्रज्ञु प्र-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the knees
far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged; (also written
प्र-ज्ञ.)

प्रज्वल् प्र-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.)
-ज्वलति (-ते), -ज्वलितुम्, to catch fire, begin to burn
or blaze, be in flames, flame, blaze up; to blaze
brightly, shine, gleam; to be inflamed or incensed,
become wrathful, to be kindled (e. g. तेषां क्रो-
धः प्रजज्वाल, their wrath was kindled): Caus.
-ज्वलयति, -ज्वालयति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, light,
kindle, inflame; (with Buddhists) to explain, illus-
trate.

प्र-ज्वलन, अम्, n. blazing up, flaming, burn-
ing, taking fire, kindling.

प्र-ज्वलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set on fire,
inflammable.

प्र-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in flames, flaming,
burning, blazing, shining, bright, radiant; blazed
forth, burnt; (अम्), n. flaming up, blazing, burning.

प्र-ज्वालित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted, kindled, set on
fire.

प्रज्वार प्र-ज्वार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ज्वर् with
प्र), the heat of fever (sometimes personified).

प्राजक प्राजक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अज् with प्र),
a driver, charioteer, coachman.
प्राजिक, अस्, m. a hawk.
प्राजितृ, ता, m. a driver, charioteer, coachman.
प्राजिन्, ई, m. = प्राजिक.

प्राजहित प्राजहित, अस्, m., Ved. a Gārha-
patya fire maintained during a longer period of time,
an older Gārhapatya fire.

प्राजापत प्राजापत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजा-
पति), see Gaṇa Mahiṣyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 48.

प्राजापत्य, अस्, आ (or ती), अम्, belonging to
or derived from Prajā-pati, relating to Prajā-pati,
sacred to Prajā-pati; (अस्), m., with or without
विवाह or विधि, the third or according to Manu
the fourth form of marriage (that in which the
father gives his daughter to the bridegroom without
receiving a present from him, but with the convic-
tion that the two will live faithfully together, Manu
III. 30); scil. उपवास, a kind of penance (lasting
twelve days, food being eaten during the first three
once in the morning, during the next three once in
the evening, in the next three only if given as
alms, and a plenary fast being observed during the
three remaining days); scil. तिथि, the eighth day in
the dark half of the month Pauṣa; a patronymic
of Pataṅ-ga; of Prajā-vat; of Yakṣma-nāśana; of
Yajña; of Vimada; of Viṣṇu; of Saṃvaraṇa; of
Hiraṇya-garbha; (with Jainas) N. of the first black
Vāsudeva; a N. of the confluence of the Gaṅgā and
Yamunā, = प्र-याग; (अम्), n. a particular sacrifice
performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue
in default of male heirs; scil. भ or नक्षत्र,
the asterism Rohiṇī; generative energy, procreative
power; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), the heaven or
sphere of the Manes, = पितृ-लोक; (आ), f. giving
away the whole of one's property before entering
upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant; a patro-
nymic of Dakṣiṇā; scil. शकटी, N. of an asterism,
the chariot of Rohiṇī (probably = α β γ δ ε Tauri).
—प्राजापत्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition
of belonging or referring to Prajā-pati.

प्राजापत्यक, अस्, &c., belonging or referring
or sacred to Prajā-pati.

प्राजावत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजा-वत्), see Gaṇa
Mahiṣyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 48.

प्राजेश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजेश), Ved. sacred to
Prajā-pati; (अम्), n. the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī.
प्राजेश प्राजेश, प्राजेश्वर. See above.

प्राजेश्वर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजेश्वर), sacred to
Prajā-pati.
प्राजिधर प्राजिधर, अस्, m., N. of a man.
प्राजिमठिका प्राजिमठिका, f., N. of a place.

प्राज्य प्राज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र with rt. अज्
or fr. प्र + आज्य, clarified butter used for obla-
tions?), abundant, plentiful, much, many, great, im-
portant; lofty.
—प्राज्य-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the
author of the Rājāvali-patākā.
—प्राज्य-विक्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, possessing great power.
—प्राज्य-वृष्टि,
इस्, इस्, इ, sending rain in abundance (said of Indra).
प्र-ज्वाला, f. a flame, blazing up.
